extractedPages.text: 1 QA Completeness and Financial Cross-Check Review Glass Recycle Curaçao – government submission pack Prepared April 6, 2026 Purpose This review was completed before the refreshed government-submission package was finalized. The objective was to verify that the workbook, the detailed business plan and the master compendium are numerically aligned, that the ancillary-product branch is fully included where it should be, and that earlier traceability information is preserved without leaving misleading “core-only” numbers in the main narrative. Key findings corrected  The main business-plan OPEX section originally described the foam-glass core only. The official section now includes the ancillary-product branch in revenue, OPEX, EBITDA and EBITDA margin.  The ancillary branch totals in the integrated screens were corrected from rounded/intermediate values to the exact modeled totals: $361,200 annual revenue, $169,000 annual direct cost and $192,200 annual EBITDA.  Strategic-scenario tables in the compendium were harmonized to the corrected integrated workbook outputs so that all summary tables now tell the same story.  The pure foam-glass reference view was preserved in dedicated Core_*_Reference sheets so that no earlier information was deleted. Corrected financial anchors Metric Official base case Lean Curaçao 70 105-ABC screen Total revenue $4.184m $4.184m $6.096m Total OPEX $2.796m $2.702m $3.551m EBITDA $1.389m $1.482m $2.545m Ancillary branch $361.2k revenue / $192.2k EBITDA $361.2k revenue / $192.2k EBITDA Same branch retained in screening Workbook QA checklist A separate XLSX checklist is included in the pack to document the detailed workbook checks. The integrated model now contains an in-model QA_Checklist sheet as well. Check area Source Status Comment Ancillary totals Ancillary_Products PASS Revenue, direct cost and EBITDA totals match the line-item sums. Main business-plan base case OPEX_Revenue PASS Ancillary branch included in revenue, OPEX and EBITDA. Official 10-year model 10Y_Model PASS Ancillary branch included in revenue, OPEX and operating cash flow.

2 Lean phase-1 screen Integrated_OPEX / Strategic_Scenarios PASS Corrected ancillary totals propagated to scenario tables. Document alignment Business Plan / Compendium PASS Main financial paragraphs, tables and charts updated and re- synchronized. Files added / refreshed in this issue  01_Detailed_Business_Plan_Curacao_Foam_Glass.docx / .pdf  02_C_Level_Executive_Summary.docx / .pdf  06_Master_Compendium_All_in_One.docx / .pdf  07_QA_Completeness_Review.docx / .pdf  Glass_Recycle_Curacao_Detailed_Model.xlsx  08_Financial_QA_Checklist.xlsx Conclusion After correction, the submission pack presents one consistent financial story. The ancillary-product branch is now carried through the main OPEX bridge, the strategic-scenario screens and the principal summary tables. The package is therefore materially cleaner and more defensible for a government review process than the prior issue.
